_comment: Booking payload the in-call receptionist workflow EMITS to the downstream booking workflow. Exact shape provided by the booking workflow. The receptionist fills every field during the call, sets status='pending', and submits. The booking workflow validates availability, assigns booking_reference, and returns status='confirmed'.

_field_sources.customer.name: Step: Understand — caller's name
_field_sources.customer.phone: Step: Understand — read back to confirm
_field_sources.customer.email: Step: Understand — optional, for the confirmation
_field_sources.service: Step: Identify — what they want done (from {{services}})
_field_sources.appointment_type: Step: Qualify — e.g. new patient / returning, consult / treatment, in-person / video
_field_sources.provider: Step: Qualify — specific staff member if requested, else 'any'
_field_sources.date: Step: Act — chosen slot date (YYYY-MM-DD) from check_availability
_field_sources.time: Step: Act — chosen slot time (HH:mm, 24h) from check_availability
_field_sources.location: Step: Qualify — branch/clinic if multi-site, else the main {{area}} location
_field_sources.qualification_answers: Step: Qualify — answers to screening questions (see qualification_questions)
_field_sources.booking_reference: Filled by the BOOKING workflow on confirm (leave empty when submitting)
_field_sources.status: 'pending' on submit -> 'confirmed' (or 'waitlist'/'declined') after the booking workflow runs
